name: @app/aether-audio-native
description: Aether 2.0 audio layer for React Native. Tone.js (web) becomes expo-av (native) + precomputed AAC drone loops keyed by destination. The pure math (destination keys / note picker / scene mixer / scene-audio-bridge) ships verbatim from @app/aether-audio; this package adds the native AudioEngine adapter contract for the future expo-av integration. Phase 4 native foundation, AE516.
